verdict.rationale: Docs describe a multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped access control and per-dataset storage explicitly designed so multiple users/orgs share an instance while keeping data separate, and sessions are keyed by (user_id, session_id) for per-user short-term memory. This directly supports scoping memories per user/tenant, but evidence is vendor-documentation only with no independent or hands-on verification that cross-tenant leakage is actually prevented in practice, and no explicit mention of 'agent' or 'application' as first-class scoping dimensions beyond dataset/user. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of isolation guarantees, explicit agent/application-level scoping documentation beyond dataset and user_id.
